Context: 3. Pension Contribution

## 3. Pension Contribution  
Pension contribution payable by a Government servant during the active period of foreign service shall be based on the basic pay in the Level (in Pay Matrix) of the post held by him/her at the time of proceeding on foreign service; and in case of grant of pro forma promotion / financial upgradation while on foreign service, the same shall be based on basic pay in the Level (in Pay Matrix) fixed on such pro forma promotion / financial  
upgradation.
